title: Airline-card form
caption: `src/pages/checkout-pay-airline.js` (docs/pages.md §9). The inputs are emptied after every answer of the completion, on `pagehide` and on a back-forward cache restore.

states.label: This payment method is not available
states.detail: `AIRLINE_CARD_ENABLED` false, `airline_card_enabled_<env>` off, or suspended after 20 declines in an hour.

states.label: Reviewed: Pay €…
states.detail: Airline's card fee for brand + BIN.

states.label: Field errors (nothing sent)
states.detail: Holder, Luhn, expiry, security code length, accepted brand.

states.label: The airline declined the card
states.detail: Inputs emptied; a booking takes at most three cards.

states.label: Too many attempts
states.detail: `403 PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`: new booking or pay by card.

states.label: Confirmation in pending mode
states.detail: `504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT`, or a lost connection after which the checkout has a booking: the card is never sent again.
